newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Uncertainty over trading at Pakistani bourse.
newsitem.headline: Uncertainty over trading at Pakistani bourse.

text.p: Dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange faced uncertainty just before trading was due to start on Tuesday about whether it would be settlement day or not.
"We don't know whether Tuesday's settlement day has been postponed till Wednesday or not," dealer Rony Byramjee said.
The exchange suspended trading on Monday because of power failure and protests by dealers.
If trading started on Tuesday's settlement day stock would open mixed on squaring of positions by jobbers, he said.
The Karachi 100-index closed 5.74 points, or 0.36 percent, down at 1,593.37 amid 19 losers and two gainers in a turnover of 10 million shares on the CTS on Monday.
Pakistan Telecommunication fell 0.40 rupee to 31.65, Hub Power 0.35 to 41.50 and ICI Pakistan 0.10 to 25.
